skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply quantitative analysis techniques in microeconomics.
Apply microeconomic theories to real-world scenarios.
Perform statistical analysis using software tools like Stata.
Conduct research, analyze, synthesize, and generalize microeconomic issues.
Collaborate effectively in group settings to solve assigned tasks.
Develop self-study and research skills to enhance knowledge on economic growth issues.
Adhere to class rules, attend classes punctually, and actively participate in presentations and debates.
Convert theoretical models into suitable econometric models.
Clean and preprocess data for econometric analysis.
Perform various types of regression analysis including OLS, logistic, and probit models.
Analyze panel data using econometric models.
Measure productivity and efficiency using econometric techniques.
Effectively present and discuss econometric results.
